caseName: I. L. F. Y. Co. v. Temporary State Housing Rent Commission
caseNameFull: I. L. F. Y. CO. v. TEMPORARY STATE HOUSING RENT COMMISSION Et Al.
attorneys: Robert S. Fougner for appellant., Harold Zucker, Robert E. Herman and Edward V. Alfieri for the State Rent Commission, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
